name: Vegetarianism
overview: Scripture reveals that God's original provision for humanity was plant-based food, as He gave every herb and fruit-bearing tree for nourishment (Genesis 1:29-30). After the Flood, God expanded this provision to include all moving creatures for food, while commanding that their blood not be eaten (Genesis 9:3-4). The Bible also values the attitude of the heart in eating, highlighting that a simple meal of herbs with love is preferable to a lavish feast marked by strife (Proverbs 15:17). These passages show a progression in dietary instructions rooted in God's sovereign provision and moral order.
